senses.gloss: f.(b. h. כִּרַיִם; cmp. כּוּר II)a portable stove on feet, with caves for two pots, v. כּוּפָּח.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 6:1">Kel. VI, 1</cite> <he>העושה שתי … כ׳</he> if one improvises a stove by means of two stones; <cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 5:3">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. V, 3</cite> <he>כרה</he> ed. Zuck. (R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 6:4">Kel. VI, 4</cite> <cite ref="K00619"><he>כירה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 6:2">Kel. VI, 2</cite> <he>כִּירַת הטבחים</he> the butchers’ stove (improvised with several stones).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 2:4:3">Y. Bets. II, 61ᶜ</cite> top <he>בשאה שכִּירָתְךָ סתומה</he> at a time when thine own (private) stove is closed (when you are not permitted to cook), opp. <he>כירת רבך</he> thy Master’s stove (the altar); Bab.
<cite ref="Beitzah 20b">Bets. 20ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Chagigah 2:10">Tosef. Ḥag. II, 10</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="K00632"><he>כִּירִים</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 6:3">Kel. VI, 3</cite> <he>שתי כ׳</he> two fire-places.—Dual form: <cite ref="K00631"><he>כִּירַיִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="K00631"><he>כִּירַיִם</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 8:7">B. Mets. VIII, 7</cite>. Sifra Sh’mini Mill. <he>לא … אלא מן הכ׳</he> they brought the fire in from the (private) stove; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 20:8">Lev. R. s. 20</cite>; Tanḥ. Aḥaré 6; ed. Bub. 7 <he>מבית</he> (<cite ref="E00000"><he>ה</he></cite>)<he>כ׳</he> from the kitchen.
<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 12:13">Ab. d’R. N. ch. XII</cite> <he>כ׳ זה טמא</he> (Var. <he>כ׳ זו טמאה</he>; v. II Vers., ed. Schechter, ch. XXVIII) this stove is unclean.
